records.title: Need More Skill Points? The Easiest Feats in DCUO (Quick Guide) DC Universe Tips and Tricks
records.scope: Vendor style and salvage preparation route
records.evidence: Reviewed the English auto-generated transcript. Supports a vendor style circuit and optional salvage planning; does not establish guaranteed point totals, costs or current vendor inventory.

chapters.title: Start a faction-appropriate vendor circuit
chapters.instruction: Use Gotham and Metropolis safehouse vendors for your faction. Check which styles are uncollected and which complete an unfinished set before purchasing.

chapters.title: Collect styles before moving to the next vendor
chapters.instruction: Collect the intended styles and restore your normal equipment before continuing. Verify the style and set counters in the Feats menu.

chapters.title: Optional salvage pass
chapters.instruction: If pursuing salvage feats, check eligibility and protect equipped, valuable and uncollected items before salvaging spare gear. This is optional and consumes the item.

chapters.title: Reduce travel between safehouses
chapters.instruction: Use safehouse transport to continue the circuit instead of repeatedly returning to the city warp menu.

chapters.title: Separate Source Mark purchases from the cash circuit
chapters.instruction: Inspect currency costs when moving to headquarters vendors. Make a separate plan for Source Mark purchases rather than spending the currency on an unchecked shopping list.
